verdict.rationale: Supabase's Postgres full-text search guide documents to_tsvector/to_tsquery search directly against the project's own database, requiring no external search service like Elasticsearch or Algolia. This is native, well-documented Postgres functionality exposed as first-class guidance. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of full-text search performance/usage at scale, and no mention of more advanced ranking or ANN/vector-hybrid search integration in this specific guide.
